description: This file defines a static helper class 'ReferencedAssemblyProvider' used for gathering relevant assemblies in the Orleans.Serialization.Internal namespace. It provides methods to load assemblies based on application parts and dependency contexts, especially handling different .NET runtime versions and contexts.

methods.name: GetRelevantAssemblies
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of assemblies relevant to the current application context, combining loaded assemblies and those specified as application parts.

methods.name: AddAssembly
methods.description: Adds an assembly to the collection if it meets criteria and includes all referenced application parts.

methods.name: AddFromDependencyContext
methods.description: Loads assemblies referenced in the dependency context of the provided assembly or the entry assembly, filtering by 'Orleans.Serialization'.

methods.name: AddFromAssemblyLoadContext
methods.description: Loads assemblies from a specified AssemblyLoadContext, if provided.

methods.name: AddFromAssemblyLoadContext
methods.description: Loads assemblies from the load context associated with a specific assembly or the current assembly, if 'assembly' is null.

methods.name: GetApplicationPartAssemblies
methods.description: Expands an assembly into a collection of related assemblies based on 'ApplicationPartAttribute' attributes and their references.
